How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

A sovereign digital commerce stack typically consists of a hosting platform, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, a backend logic engine, like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, an order storage solution, such as Supabase or Google Sheets, and a file delivery system, such as Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The stack is further powered by NOWPayments, a crypto payment gateway that enables automatic on-chain payment verification with a 0.5% fee.
